title: Usage surface: lag-aware inactivity per person on SCR-usage

outcomes.statement: Group Admins see, on SCR-usage (/uso), per-person last activity and days inactive for their companies against a lag-aware data-through date, with company and 30/60/90 window filters, active/flagged/no-data metric cards, window and state badges, and the ~3-day freshness banner.
outcomes.demo: Seed two companies with activity at varied ages and a vendor account synced three days ago: /uso as group_admin lists only own-company people, days inactive counts from the data-through date (a person last active on the last synced day shows 0, not 3), the 30/60/90 filter changes the badge set and metric cards, people with no activity count as no data; a non-group_admin role is refused.

uncertainties.statement: Parent allocation, prerequisites and canonical policy are delivered.
uncertainties.resolution: US-027 readiness payload 2d32ab167ef76cb5b3f20561a89077d5251d16140870a6d9889bcd2e8c07fbaf is approved by Francisco and assigns this official child; US-026 has terminal done evidence. CHG-071 delivered DEC-SMP-026/027/028, BR-16 and US-072. AC1/AC4 describe the authorized usage surface; AC2/AC3 describe lag-aware classification, totaling two acceptance flows. No approved parent design exists; this child requires its own approved readiness, design and bound plan before implementation.

uncertainties.statement: Shared lag/window math must distinguish activity observation from positive activity without introducing another package scope.
uncertainties.resolution: Use packages/domain for the pure function and its exported read-model types; server validates query filters with existing zod, without changes to packages/contracts. Thus the three major scopes are domain, server and ui. data_through uses the latest synced activity_date for the vendor account, fallback evaluation date minus three days. Inspect normalized counters to distinguish known-zero days from positive activity and absent data; make supported counter interpretation, strict >30/>60/>90 boundaries, UTC dates and null handling explicit in the design before approval. Stop and request policy reconciliation if provider active-user semantics cannot be established from delivered contracts/specs. Property-based tests constrain monotonicity and boundary math; US-074 reuses this function.

uncertainties.statement: Usage is currently a scaffold; tenant and account grains need explicit design.
uncertainties.resolution: Read open assignments joined to Person, Company, VendorAccount, LicenseType and anchor LicenseRequest through the shared drizzle client. Filter every company-owned relation by the actor company scope; ActivityRecord has no company_id and must join through scoped Person/account identities. Explicitly refuse a foreign-company filter and non-group_admin. Design assignment/person-account grain and metric denominator before implementation, preserving separate vendor-account evidence for multi-license people. No schema migration, state mutation, proposal action or new route; /uso already exists. Record unchanged wall-clock inactive-candidate queries in pool-repository.ts and read-repository.ts as the canonical deferred divergence.

uncertainties.statement: The screen must show correct filtered metrics, state badges and account-specific freshness.
uncertainties.resolution: Reuse existing authenticated Server Component, authorization, locale and design-token patterns. Company and window query filters drive server-derived cards and rows; keep persisted request state distinct from calculated window qualification. Name data_through per account/row and avoid treating the freshest account as freshness for all accounts. Include no-data, empty, refused, loading and error behavior, deterministic two-company/multi-account real-DB fixtures and rendered behavior checks. Batch selection/proposal modal is US-073; daily flagging/un-flagging is US-074. An extra interface or independently valuable outcome triggers reassessment.

uncertainties.statement: CHG-070 measurement and verification must follow the consolidated-session experiment.
uncertainties.resolution: One implementer session for all tasks with per-task commits; one reused scoped-review session, plus a fresh adversarial AC reviewer. Controller plans, briefs and decides without running child verification; at most three controller sessions and none above about 200K context. Implementer launches background touched-shard previews after focused-green, one round per task plus final fix wave, <=30 preview minutes, slow shards once in final unless touched. Hold /tmp/smp-full-gate.lock during every caffeinate -i pnpm check, remove in finally, and establish cold TURBO_FORCE=true base-green before execution. Phase markers carry UTC ts; actuals record preview rounds/minutes, one authoritative campaign, loops and phase time. Measure costs from available transcript usage including cache input, deduplicated by message/call identity; mark inaccessible metrics estimated and require nous independent agreement within 20% before CHG-070 closes. Include implementer/reviewer cost and session-count lines in root_cause, controller cost on done, and normalized tokens/product-line and estimate-minute comparisons. CHG-070 readiness currently fails WR_APPROVAL_ORDER on its historical preapproval started/phase records; preserve history, report the issue, and require a valid governing assessment before experiment execution. The separate CHG-072 feedback-order diagnostic is nonblocking.
